annotations.title: NWS hourly forecast batch (up to 10 US points)

description: NWS hourly forecast batch (up to 10 US points) — Hourly National Weather Service forecasts for up to 10 US locations in one call, with per-point high/low, peak rain chance and the first hour rain is likely (50%+), plus a cross-point summary (wettest, hottest, coldest, where rain is likely). Pass ?points= as Label lat,lon separated by semicolons and optional ?hours=1-48 (default 12). Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_hourly_batch
